name: WI-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's D+26 partisan lean, among the most Democratic in the nation
Incumbent Gwen Moore running with a large fundraising edge over an opponent reporting no money
No competitive polls, expert ratings, or outside spending; prediction markets price Moore at 97%
model.rationale: A D+26 Milwaukee-area seat, an incumbent with over $1 million raised, and a Republican with no reported fundraising leave little basis for competitiveness, and prediction markets price Moore's win odds at 97%.
model.watch: Only an unexpected shock, such as heavy late outside spending against Moore or a major scandal, would put this seat in play.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Milwaukee-area WI-04 is one of the most Democratic districts in the country, with a partisan lean of D+26. Gwen Moore is the incumbent and is running again after being renominated. She has raised just over $1 million, though she ends with limited cash on hand, while Republican Tim Rogers reports no fundraising and no outside groups are active on either side. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, and prediction markets price Moore at about a 97% chance of holding the seat.

The fundamentals point the same direction: recent national conditions favor Democrats, incumbency adds a cushion, and Moore's fundraising advantage is decisive against an opponent with no visible war chest. An independent candidate is on the ballot but has no reported fundraising. Everything in the record points to a comfortable Moore victory by a wide margin.
